outcomeParity.outcome: Search across figures, articles, and topics then resume browsing without state loss.
outcomeParity.iosExpression: Visible close and system Back dismiss the search overlay; keyboard/focus returns to its invoker.
outcomeParity.androidExpression: Visible close and system/predictive Back dismiss the search overlay before leaving People page.
outcomeParity.differenceReason: Each platform owns the back gesture/system behavior; saved browsing outcome remains identical.
outcomeParity.acceptanceSignal: Topic, dynasty, expansion, scroll position, and invoking-control focus are restored.

outcomeParity.outcome: Return safely from article and figure detail.
outcomeParity.iosExpression: Navigation stack and edge Back pop to saved People page context.
outcomeParity.androidExpression: System/predictive Back pops to saved People page context.
outcomeParity.differenceReason: Native back interactions differ, but both return to the logical parent context.
outcomeParity.acceptanceSignal: The app does not exit early and prior People-page filters/expansions/scroll are intact.

outcomeParity.outcome: Use every result, filter, and recovery action with large text and assistive technology.
outcomeParity.iosExpression: Dynamic Type reflows content; VoiceOver exposes order, labels, selection, and status.
outcomeParity.androidExpression: Font scaling reflows content; TalkBack exposes order, labels, selection, and status.
outcomeParity.differenceReason: Accessibility settings and APIs are platform-specific.
outcomeParity.acceptanceSignal: No task-critical control is clipped, unnamed, color-only, or gesture-only.

outcomeParity.outcome: Recover from invalid notification links without requiring notification permission.
outcomeParity.iosExpression: Invalid target gives recovery to People page; notification authorization is optional.
outcomeParity.androidExpression: Invalid target gives recovery to People page; notification permission is optional.
outcomeParity.acceptanceSignal: People page is browseable after any denied, expired, missing, or unauthorized target.

rules.statement: Use hierarchical detail routes; iOS edge Back must return to the saved People page context and a visible Back control must be available.
rules.verification: Manual iPhone test from article, figure, and search states.

rules.statement: System and predictive Back must dismiss search before leaving People page and return from detail to the saved parent context.
rules.verification: Android emulator/device test including predictive Back gesture.

rules.statement: Respect safe areas and keyboard occlusion; support Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, Reduce Motion, and 44 pt default interactive targets.
rules.verification: iPhone test with large Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, keyboard, and Reduce Motion.

rules.statement: Handle edge-to-edge insets and system gesture regions; support scalable text, TalkBack, reduced animation, and 48 dp interactive targets.
rules.verification: Android device/emulator test with font scale, TalkBack, insets, and gesture navigation.

rules.statement: Search dismissal and detail return restore independent topic/dynasty filters, expansion states, scroll position, and focus where applicable.
rules.verification: Widget/integration test plus manual iOS/Android verification.

rules.statement: Do not treat an in-memory snapshot as durable after recreation; define restoration for relevant People-page context and reflow on available form factors.
rules.verification: Process recreation and adaptive-window device matrix.

rules.statement: Notifications are secondary entry points; denied permission or invalid targets must not block People-page discovery and must provide a safe fallback.

checks.target: iOS navigation stack, edge Back, and People-page state restore
checks.fix: Use one hierarchical route stack and explicitly preserve People-page context across overlay/detail navigation.
checks.verification: Run manual iPhone edge-Back and visible-Back cases with non-default filters, expansion, scroll, and search origin.

checks.target: Android system/predictive Back and People-page state restore
checks.fix: Integrate route/back dispatcher so search closes first and detail returns to logical parent context.
checks.verification: Run Android gesture navigation and predictive Back cases from search/article/figure.

checks.target: iOS safe area, keyboard, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and Reduce Motion
checks.fix: Use safe/keyboard insets, semantic labels/live regions, focus restoration, reflowing text, and reduced-motion fade.
checks.verification: Test on iPhone with largest planned Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, on-screen keyboard, and Reduce Motion.

checks.target: Android edge-to-edge, scalable text, TalkBack, and touch targets
checks.fix: Respect WindowInsets and gesture regions; audit semantics, 48 dp targets, font scaling, and reduced animation.
checks.verification: Test on gesture-navigation Android device/emulator with large font scale and TalkBack.

checks.target: Android process recreation, background/resume, and adaptive layout
checks.fix: Decide persistence/restoration boundaries and build reflow rather than uniform canvas scaling.
checks.verification: Recreate process during search/detail and test compact, landscape, tablet/foldable, and multi-window where supported.

checks.target: Notification permission and valid/invalid deep-link recovery
checks.fix: Keep People page primary; validate target/authorization and display recovery with People-page destination.
checks.verification: Deny notifications, return from Settings, and invoke valid, missing, expired, and unauthorized links.

fallbacks.deniedOrUnavailableState: User denies, defers, or cannot grant notifications.
fallbacks.inAppFallback: People page remains reachable through primary navigation; no discovery task is blocked.
fallbacks.coreValuePreserved: Users can browse featured articles, topic articles, and figures without push.

fallbacks.deniedOrUnavailableState: Article or figure target is invalid, expired, deleted, or unauthorized.
fallbacks.inAppFallback: Show a minimal unavailable explanation and offer the People page as a browseable recovery target.
fallbacks.coreValuePreserved: Users resume content discovery instead of reaching a dead end.

fallbacks.deniedOrUnavailableState: Keyboard obscures input or Back is invoked while search is active.
fallbacks.inAppFallback: Keep input above keyboard; Back/close dismisses search and restores focus/context on People page.
fallbacks.coreValuePreserved: Search can be exited without losing browsing context.

conditions: Implement and verify platform-owned Back behavior and People-page state restoration.
Verify iOS safe-area/keyboard/Dynamic Type/VoiceOver/Reduce Motion behavior on device.
Verify Android edge-to-edge/predictive Back/process recreation/font scale/TalkBack behavior on device.
Confirm notification/deep-link policy and test invalid target recovery.
